Minor UI-state defect, verifiable from the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6#save`, the client always does `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')` and after a successful save forcibly sets `host.category` from `Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))`. On the server, `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` explicitly falls back to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` when `category_id` is blank. If the user saves without choosing a category (i.e., `categoryId` remains `null`/blank on the client), the server will persist uncategorized, but the client will set `host.category` using `findById(null)` (undefined), overriding any correct server-side/defaulted category and causing the category badge to appear blank until reload/rehydration. This mismatch is directly visible in the diff (client uses local `categoryId` rather than the server-returned value).
